description: Manifest tree vectors (format 1). Each case builds a tree from a list of files and gives the expected root hash, the number of distinct nodes and the nodes in walk order (a directory's own nodes - index first, then its pages - followed by its subdirectories in name order). canonical is the exact node text (UTF-8, no trailing newline); it is listed for nodes up to 4096 bytes, larger nodes give size and hash only. Cases with error must be rejected by Build (write-time rules) with that path error kind. decode_invalid lists node bytes (bytes_hex, or node_gen for large nodes, whose expansion hashes to bytes_sha256) that a strict decoder must reject under the read-time rules. decode_valid_build_rejects lists node bytes (bytes_hex) that a decoder must accept (the read-time rules do not depend on Unicode tables) but that the write path never produces: write_rule names the write-time rule they violate (nfc: a name is not in NFC; case_conflict; unassigned_char; disallowed_char: the fixed list of bidi and invisible characters, a write-time rule only). Cases with ucd_version depend on the Unicode version (V = 15.0.0): a checker whose Unicode tables have another version must skip them. walk_order, where given, is the expected list of full paths in walk order (pre-order, entries in byte order of their names: the path order). walk_valid and walk_invalid are whole trees given as nodes (hex, or node_gen) plus the root hash; a reader that walks the tree must accept walk_valid and reject walk_invalid with the error category: invalid_node (a node violates the single-node rules of spec 3.8) or invalid_tree (every node decodes, but the tree violates the whole-tree rules of spec 3.6 and 3.8).
inputs: files: {path, content (UTF-8 text), mode (default 420)}; the file's hash is sha256 of content and its size is the byte length. generate: for i in [start, start+count): path = dir + '/' + prefix*prefix_repeat + zero-padded decimal i (digits wide), or without 'dir/' when dir is empty; content = UTF-8 bytes of the path; mode 420.
generators: node_gen: a node of the given kind with count items named prefix + the zero-padded decimal index (digits wide) for index in [start, start+count): file entries {hash of the empty content, mode 420, size 0} for dir and dir_page, references {count 1, first = name, hash of the empty content} for dir_index; the bytes are the canonical encoding (spec 3.1), names are not checked.
